name: a stale list certificate is still marked
a stale visit skips the subtree
a stale run proof skips rebuilding
stale open generation bypasses the state fence
stale sweeping generation bypasses the state fence
replace:
s.revision = Current \/ Skip = s.gen
                THEN s.gen

s.revision = Current \/ Skip = s.gen \/ s.gen = "sweeping"
                THEN s.gen

s.revision = Current \/ Skip = s.gen
              THEN s.adoption

s.revision = Current \/ Skip = s.gen \/ s.gen = "sweeping"
              THEN s.adoption
